implementation.transport: globalThis.fetch (native fetch); intentionally not the axios/RPC officialEgress transport
local_compatibility_extensions: Positive max_results/count values are preserved; 0/missing selects the official default 5.
URL-only WebFetch remains accepted by supplying prompt="".
Explicit timeout seconds 1..120 and max_length 1..1000000 are gateway bounds, not claims about upstream documented limits.
model_name may be explicitly supplied; otherwise the selected model routing prefix cn:/global: is removed for WebFetch.
The same deadline also bounds response-body reading to retain a gateway resource safeguard; native search clears its local timer after fetch headers.
Downstream fetch keeps the existing JSON/content validation and URL-backfill compatibility wrapper; agentTool returns successful upstream text unchanged.

unknowns: Static construction does not prove real network wire equality or identical host Node/OpenSSL TLS fingerprints.
Per-session context IDs are empty if absent from incoming correlation headers; no real WorkBuddy session was acquired.
Per-account departmentFullName and optional configured custom-header/IOA overrides are not available from the current account schema and were not read from user settings.
Local-agent is the gateway desktop profile default; the specimen runtime resolver additionally supports session/environment/OpenTelemetry overrides.
